title: The guard reads the folder of a command that follows a heredoc, so a destructive git after it is judged in its own folder
why: Lane draft-pr-guard-heredoc, 15:14 CST Nov 8, per the coordinator's 15:00 CST ruling. Hole on main: a heredoc to notes.md, then `cd <dirty> && git reset --hard HEAD`, run from a clean cwd, is allowed. _run_dir's second strip drops the tail, so rule shared-tree reads the clean cwd. Branch run-dir-unclosed-tail, from #1915's head, Merge after #1915.
note: Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was [ended:draft-pr-guard-heredoc]).
